findings.note: The Senate roll call printed in the Assembly floor analysis lists Gonzalez among the 30 yes votes for SB 1174, which bars local governments from requiring ID to vote at polling places or other places where ballots are cast. The page gives the surname only; she is the only senator named Gonzalez in 2024. Date of the Senate vote comes from a news report that the bill cleared the Senate floor May 21.
